source.public_versification_note: Public Numbers 31–36 align directly with all 228 corresponding Hebrew records. Each original XML record is hashed in full. Earlier Numbers numbering differences and the two-record binding at public 26:1 remain preserved in earlier ledgers.

key_decisions.decision: Preserves the reciprocal departure-stage wording and notes the command phrase’s possible attachment.
Retains the exact date and ancient raised-hand image, explained selectively in vocabulary.
Keeps the Hahiroth form, sea crossing, three days and Etham designation without harmonizing to another itinerary.
Preserves the explicit Kadesh identification and Zin rather than Sin.
Retains the shortened Iyim form instead of silently replacing it with the preceding full name. Uses “left” for the repeated departure verb while keeping the source’s itinerary formula.
Keeps dispossession explicit and distinguishes three cultic objects or sites, with uncertainty over figured stones noted.
Retains the painful bodily imagery and the warning’s stated condition.
Keeps the reversal directed against Israel without qualifying away its force.
